target.title: Price Revelation from Insider Trading: Evidence from Hacked Earnings News
target.principle: Reproduce the published JFE study with the authors' original data lineage and published processing rules. Alternative vendors may be used for validation only unless the original source is unavailable and the deviation is explicitly labeled.

canonical_sample_construction: Start from Compustat-reported earnings announcement dates during 2010-2015.
Require share price > $1 and market capitalization > $5 million.
Require NYSE, NYSE Amex/MKT, or NASDAQ listing and CRSP share code 10 or 11.
Require at least one I/B/E/S analyst forecast in the 90 days before the announcement.
Exclude announcements during regular trading hours.
Assign the earnings press release to its newswire using RavenPack Press Release and Dow Jones editions.
Drop announcements without an assigned press release.
Drop observations without prior-trading-day TAQ intraday returns or a following CRSP opening price.
Restrict the main analysis to the newswires that were hacked at some point.
Published final sample: 43,687 announcements, 8,980 exposed to hacks.

exact_measure_rules.absolute_order_imbalance: abs((buy market-order shares - sell market-order shares) / (buy market-order shares + sell market-order shares)); trade direction inferred using Lee-Ready for TAQ
exact_measure_rules.quoted_spread: NBBO quoted spread aggregated by time weighting; use log-price spread definition from the paper appendix/Holden-Jacobsen lineage
exact_measure_rules.effective_spread: 2 * trade direction * (log trade price - log contemporaneous NBBO midpoint), dollar-volume weighted
exact_measure_rules.realized_spread: 2 * trade direction * (log trade price - log NBBO midpoint five minutes later), dollar-volume weighted
exact_measure_rules.price_impact: 2 * trade direction * (log NBBO midpoint five minutes later - log contemporaneous midpoint), dollar-volume weighted
exact_measure_rules.monthly_share_turnover: monthly dollar stock trade volume / market capitalization, month before earnings announcement
exact_measure_rules.monthly_option_turnover: monthly option trade volume / shares outstanding, month before earnings announcement
exact_measure_rules.earnings_surprise: (actual EPS - median analyst forecast) / stock price five trading days before announcement
exact_measure_rules.story_count_control: natural log of newswire stories about the firm in the quarter leading to the earnings announcement; exact RavenPack relevance cutoff remains unresolved
